page.content:
Reincarnation order: water, earth, fire, air.

How Avatar cycle connects

  • Character: Aang — Aang is the Avatar of his turn in the cycle.
  • Character: Korra — Korra is the Avatar after Aang.
  • Character: Avatar Roku — Roku is the Avatar before Aang.

What is Avatar cycle?

The Avatar cycle reincarnates through the four nations in order, tying Roku to Aang to Korra and binding the world to one spirit in many lives.

Key threads lead to Aang, Korra and Avatar Roku.
